changes.title: Graham Platner makes it official in Maine, submitting paperwork to leave Senate race
changes.summary: In his withdrawal notice, Platner said "people are desperate for change" and that's why they made him the Democratic nominee. Now, Maine Democrats have to pick someone to replace him by July 27. (Image credit: CJ Gunther).
